say:1:1621779001:1.text: Thank you so much for saving me.

say:2:1621779002:1.text: I did some soul-searching last night... Even though life's tough, and I yearn to be the best version of myself...
say:2:1621779002:1.source_cn: 昨天晚上我想了很久……虽然现实很艰难，虽然我也很向往镜...

say:3:1621779003:1.source_cn: 但是，果然还是要活下去啊。

say:4:1621779004:1.text: I might never reach the top as a mage my whole life, but at least... I can still use magic, and I'm passionate about it. If I threw my life away, that's when I'd lose everything.
say:4:1621779004:1.source_cn: 就算天资平庸，注定无法走到魔法的顶端……但至少，我还能...

say:5:1621779005:1.text: I'll keep working hard, find my place, and live life the way I want!
say:5:1621779005:1.source_cn: 我会继续努力学习，找到自己适合的领域，以自己想要的方式...

say:7:1621779006:1.source_cn: 吉罗德的心态变得积极了好多！

say:8:1621779007:1.text: Sometimes it takes a life‑changing event to gain clarity. What a blessing in disguise!
say:8:1621779007:1.source_cn: 应该是在生死边境走过一遭后，就想通了吧？因祸得福啊！

say:9:1621779008:1.text: Stop trying to sound all wise and grown-up, Leo! You're just a silly little kid!
say:9:1621779008:1.source_cn: 笨蛋利奥，明明自己也都什么不懂，还装作大人说深奥的话。

say:10:1621779009:1.text: But I agree, it was a blessing in disguise. Despite all the twists and turns, I'm glad things ended positively.
say:10:1621779009:1.source_cn: 不过有一件事你说得对，的确是因祸得福。虽然整件事很惊险...
say:10:1621779009:1.male: But I agree, it was a blessing in disguise. Despite all the twists and turns, I'm glad things ended positively.
say:10:1621779009:1.female: But I agree, it was a blessing in disguise. Despite all the twists and turns, I'm glad things ended positively.

say:11:1621779010:1.text: I suggest we go out for a nice meal to celebrate Girod's rebirth!
say:11:1621779010:1.source_cn: 我提议——去餐厅吃顿好的，庆祝吉罗德的新生！

say:13:1621779011:1.text: Sure! Let me take care of the bill—I owe you that much after you saved my life.
say:13:1621779011:1.source_cn: 好啊，请务必让我请客，感谢一下你们的救命之恩！
